commands:
set -euo pipefail; git fetch origin agent-control >/dev/null; git show origin/agent-control:.agent/payloads/tracker-phase3-room-refresh-e2e-v3.sh > /tmp/tracker-phase3-room-refresh-e2e-v4.sh; python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
p=Path('/tmp/tracker-phase3-room-refresh-e2e-v4.sh')
s=p.read_text()
old='APKSIGNER="$(find "$HOME/Library/Android/sdk/build-tools" -type f -name apksigner 2>/dev/null | sort | tail -n1)"\ntest -x "$APKSIGNER"'
new='APKSIGNER="$HOME/Library/Android/sdk/build-tools/36.0.0/apksigner"\nif [ ! -x "$APKSIGNER" ]; then APKSIGNER="$(command -v apksigner || true)"; fi\necho "apksigner=$APKSIGNER"\ntest -x "$APKSIGNER"'
if old not in s:
    raise SystemExit('expected apksigner preflight not found')
p.write_text(s.replace(old,new,1))
PY
chmod +x /tmp/tracker-phase3-room-refresh-e2e-v4.sh; /tmp/tracker-phase3-room-refresh-e2e-v4.sh
